description: Use to check how a website carries its videos. Reads the homepage plus up to 60 sitemap pages for YouTube embeds, facades and page-builder widgets, VideoObject nodes and their required properties, and, given a channel handle, how many of the channel's videos the site carries. Read-only. For one video use video_check; for a channel's uploads use video_channel.
name: video_site
title: Check a site's video pages
